name: Landscaped Confinement
source:
Being confined to this landscape... is like being confined to this screen.

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-31]Ludum Dare 31[/url] (Theme: Entire Game on One Screen).
translation:
被限制在这个风景里……就像被限制在这个屏幕里一样。

为 [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-31]Ludum Dare 31[/url] 创建（主题：一屏上的整个游戏）。
